headline: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir elected as Bangladesh's 23rd president with 255 votes
summary: The Election Commission has issued a gazette declaring him the winner, defeating Oli Ahmed by a margin of 167 votes.
details: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has been elected as the 23rd President of Bangladesh. He secured victory with 255 votes, defeating his opponent Oli Ahmed by a margin of 167 votes.
The Election Commission has officially published a gazette declaring Mirza Fakhrul as the president. The result has sparked celebrations in his hometown of Thakurgaon.
Professor Muhammad Yunus, the Prime Minister, and various political leaders have congratulated the new president. The Prime Minister greeted him with red roses following the election win.
International congratulations have also poured in from the United Kingdom and China, with China expressing a desire for stronger ties with Bangladesh.
Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer Dr. Shafiqur Rahman congratulated the President-elect, urging him to rise above party politics to uphold democracy and the rule of law.
Dr. Rahman highlighted Fakhrul's political experience from the 2001-2006 four-party alliance government, hoping his wisdom will contribute to national unity and social justice.
caption:
Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is the new President of Bangladesh! He won with 255 votes, defeating Oli Ahmed by a margin of 167.

Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has been elected as the 23rd President of Bangladesh. He secured victory with 255 votes, defeating his opponent Oli Ahmed by a margin of 167 votes.

The Election Commission has officially published a gazette declaring Mirza Fakhrul as the president. The result has sparked celebrations in his hometown of Thakurgaon.

Professor Muhammad Yunus, the Prime Minister, and various political leaders have congratulated the new president. The Prime Minister greeted him with red roses following the election win.

International congratulations have also poured in from the United Kingdom and China, with China expressing a desire for stronger ties with Bangladesh.

Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer Dr. Shafiqur Rahman congratulated the President-elect, urging him to rise above party politics to uphold democracy and the rule of law.

Dr. Rahman highlighted Fakhrul's political experience from the 2001-2006 four-party alliance government, hoping his wisdom will contribute to national unity and social justice.

headline: Ruhul Kabir Rizvi appointed BNP acting secretary general
summary: The party announced the appointment in a notice on Thursday, following the vacancy created by Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir.
details: Ruhul Kabir Rizvi has been appointed as the acting secretary general of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). The announcement was made by the party in a notice issued on Thursday.
Rizvi, a member of the BNP National Standing Committee, succeeds Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, who had held the party's second-highest position for a long time.

The appointment follows the vacancy created when Mirza Fakhrul stepped down from the secretary general's post after the party officially announced his name as their candidate for the presidential election on August 13.
The BNP notice stated that Advocate Ruhul Kabir Rizvi was nominated for the role in accordance with section 7(b)(6) of the party's constitution, and the appointment is effective immediately.
Prior to this, on August 15, four new leaders were included in the BNP's highest policy-making forum, the National Standing Committee, including Ruhul Kabir Rizvi.
The other newly included leaders are Aman Ullah Aman, an advisor to the BNP Chairperson, along with Farhad Halim and Md. Ismail Jabiullah.
caption:
Ruhul Kabir Rizvi takes over as the acting secretary general of the BNP.

Ruhul Kabir Rizvi has been appointed as the acting secretary general of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). The announcement was made by the party in a notice issued on Thursday.

Rizvi, a member of the BNP National Standing Committee, succeeds Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, who had held the party's second-highest position for a long time.

The appointment follows the vacancy created when Mirza Fakhrul stepped down from the secretary general's post after the party officially announced his name as their candidate for the presidential election on August 13.

The BNP notice stated that Advocate Ruhul Kabir Rizvi was nominated for the role in accordance with section 7(b)(6) of the party's constitution, and the appointment is effective immediately.

Prior to this, on August 15, four new leaders were included in the BNP's highest policy-making forum, the National Standing Committee, including Ruhul Kabir Rizvi.

The other newly included leaders are Aman Ullah Aman, an advisor to the BNP Chairperson, along with Farhad Halim and Md. Ismail Jabiullah.
